answer: Each identity must anchor a barter ledger to the anchor board. It locks 70, pays 15, and its forge output leaves only by barter for garden goods. A cash-out ring sending 1,000 fake forge outputs to a wallet leaves 1,000 unmatched; reusing a garden lot burns both. The k-th fake needs a fresh counterparty and lot, 70 locked, 15 paid: 1,000 fakes cost 70,000 locked and 15,000 fees, no bulk discount. An auditor replays the anchor board, voiding outputs with no entry, reused garden lots, or cash sales, burning the bond. An honest identity pays 15 once, recovers its forge bond after a clean epoch.
